subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: The gate shall read the contract exclusively from committed machine faces — the PRD source map, the design index and its `serves_inverse`, the DoD schema, and the governed currency-disposition projection carrying exact approval-attestation and authority-policy state — and shall not parse document prose for substance, re-run a reviewer lens, infer consumed bindings, or discover compatibility from citations not declared by a disposition.
rationale: the exception remains deterministic only when the stale edge, exact reviewed judgment, and current approval authority have closed machine faces
fit_criterion: inspection confirms these are the only substantive inputs; prose-only compatibility, an undeclared mapping, and PR/commit status without an exact attestation do not clear an edge; no code path invokes a review lens or scores semantic quality
